chars.SAAD: SAAD: a 25-year-old Moroccan man with short black hair and a trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a 24-year-old Moroccan woman wearing a lilac hijab, a long cream knitted cardigan over a dusty-pink long dress
chars.SISTER: SISTER: a young Moroccan woman with curly dark hair tied up, wearing a bottle-green tracksuit

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night inside a traditional Moroccan family house, dim warm light. The GIRL stands shyly at the end of the hallway near a carved wooden door, smiling nervously, SAAD stands close facing her, both faces visible, head-to-waist framing, romantic awkward tension.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In a dark courtyard of a Moroccan house lit only by a small lamp, SAAD gently takes the GIRL's hand in his; she looks down surprised and blushing, he looks at her smiling. Close medium shot, both faces visible.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: SAAD and the GIRL walk slowly hand in hand back toward the front of a Moroccan family house at night, street lamp glow, zellige tiles near the door, both smiling shyly, seen from the front.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan salon with long low sofas, patterned cushions and a brass tea tray; SAAD and the GIRL sit on the sofa chatting and laughing together late at night, a teapot and glasses on the low table.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night view inside a two-storey Moroccan family house: SAAD stands on the tiled staircase between the ground floor and the upper floor, pointing up toward his room upstairs, warm light, smiling.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan house bedroom doorway, the SISTER smiles and hands the GIRL a folded pair of flowered pyjamas; the GIRL takes them shyly, grateful, both faces visible.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: SAAD shows the GIRL a cosy bedroom upstairs in a Moroccan house, he lingers in the doorway leaning on the frame a little too long, she stands inside holding folded pyjamas, both looking at each other, soft lamp light.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of SAAD and the GIRL in a dim upstairs hallway exchanging a long shy look, both smiling and blushing, they clearly understand they like each other, warm romantic light.
